text: No crime in a broken-down car. No crime being Negro, neither. Button it up, Mary. Nobody wants to go to jail behind your mouth. I'll do my best, sugar. Not a great place for three of y'all to be having car trouble. We didn't pick the place, officer. They picked us. You being disrespectful? No, sir. You have identification on you? Yes, sir. Yes, sir. We're just on our way to work. We're going to be in the car. At Langley? NASA, sir. We do a great deal of the calculating. Getting our rockets into space. All three of you? Yes, sir. Yes, officer. NASA? That's something. I had no idea they hired. There are quite a few women working in the space program. I'm afraid we're going to have to go to the moon. Damn Russians are watching us right now. Sputniks. You girls ever meet those astronauts? Mercury 7? Absolutely. Uh, yes, sir. We work with those gentlemen all the time. Those boys are the best we got. I'm sure of that. Yeah. We gotta get a man up here for what the commies do. Yes. Absolutely. Whole damn country's counting on them. That's for certain. Hard being of service is broken down on the side of the road, though. Right, right. Uh, what, y'all need a tow or something? No, thank you, officer. I think I gotta, just give me my... Just need to bypass the starter. She's good at this stuff. Whoo! That a girl. We're all set. Well, hell, least I can do is give y'all an escort. I imagine you're... You're running late to work. Oh, no, sir. We wouldn't want to bother you. That would be wonderful, officer. Thank you so much, sir. Follow me. I'm...
